actual_scope: Determine the exact cut spectrum and minimum peak tensor-train bond of every equal-dimension wire permutation under arbitrary simultaneous input/output column ordering.

bottleneck_link: Side result for routing interfaces: distinguish a fixed-order cut obstruction from one that survives permissible column layout changes. Physical legality and the complete cost remain open.
stop_rule: Stop at the first verified optimal layout theorem; leave physical caller binding, uniform tables and side information as open questions.
